The '''Outer Jalor sector''' was a distant [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], and home to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kril'Dor/Legends|Kril'Dor]]. It was adjacent to [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] and [[Jalor sector/Legends|Jalor]], [[Belshar sector/Legends|Belshar]] and [[Rago sector/Legends|Rago sectors]] in the Mid Rim.
